description.value: Established in 1972, The Blarney Stone is Vancouver's longest-running Irish pub and one of the most iconic landmarks in British Columbia, housed in an 1888 building in the heart of historic Gastown that originally served as the Klondike Hotel. It draws locals and tourists alike with Irish-inspired comfort food, live music on weekends, and a boisterous atmosphere on a massive 240-inch screen for sporting events. Its location in Gastown places it directly along popular Vancouver cycling routes near the waterfront.
